summary: Iteration 46 — Verified the new pushed-update pantry pipeline (SSE /api/meals/events + Mongo meals_signal seq + X-Client-Id echo suppression). Backend: 3/3 pytest cases pass (401 no-token / 401 bad-token / baseline+signal delivered with correct scope/date/client within ~2s). Frontend: two-context Playwright confirmed Context B's daily-entry grid mirrors Context A's qty=5/rate=10 purchase save on 2026-08-01 within 1s (well under the 10s SLA). Edit protection verified: while Context B was actively typing '99', Context A saved qty=7 and B's focused input was NOT clobbered. Data cleaned up (zeroed). Wiring of liveSig into all six pantry tabs (Entry/Masters/Vendors/Wastage/CrossCheck/Expenses) confirmed via code review in MealsReport.jsx.

minor.issue: In pytest, requests.get() against the shared preview ingress can hang for tiny 401/422 responses when reusing a keep-alive connection from an earlier test. Curl and a fresh requests.Session both work in <200ms. Worked around in test by using a fresh Session per auth-check test. Not a server bug — likely emergent-preview ingress quirk with connection reuse for very-small non-2xx responses. Worth noting for future testing agents.

critical_code_review_comments: useMealsEvents.js correctly baselines on the first frame and drops own-client echoes via CLIENT_ID match; EventSource auto-reconnect + Mongo-backed monotonic seq means missed frames during disconnects still trigger exactly one refetch — solid design.

MealEntryTab liveSig effect defers refetch via setTimeout(attempt, 4000) whenever savingRef/pendingSave/purchTimer/issuesTimer are active OR isUserEditing() — prevents clobbering typing users. Confirmed empirically.
Backend _signal_meals wraps db.config.update_one in try/except so a Mongo hiccup won't break mutations — good defensive coding.
SSE stream padding (2KB comment) + Content-Encoding: identity + X-Accel-Buffering: no correctly defeats the emergent ingress' gzip/proxy buffering (confirmed: first frame lands in <1s of connect).
Signal doc is a single Mongo document with $inc — atomic and multi-worker-safe. Consumers poll every 2s so worst-case propagation is ~2s + network.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on P0 flows (two-machine live update + edit protection)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing pantry item on 2026-08-01/2026-08-02 and zeroed the qty/rate after each test.
